title: Rav Papa bar Yaakov
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chagigah 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.14a.14); the reading in the Ein Yaakov is Rav Acha bar Yaakov. The statement is likewise cited in [Yalkut Isaiah, remez 63](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.394.6).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rav Papa bar Yaakov interpreting תעלולים as “foxes, sons of foxes.” The linked Yalkut passage is remez 394:6 and gives Rabbi Acha bar Yaakov. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2993&lang=en) gives the Bavli name and reports the Acha reading in Ein Yaakov, as Hyman does.
